verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's official CLI documents a `scrapingbee crawl` command for quick same-domain crawls, sitemap crawls, or Scrapy-project spiders, so some crawling exists. Nothing in the evidence shows a selectable breadth-first strategy or a configurable maximum page limit, and the core HTML API is single-URL. Missing for 10: documented breadth-first crawl strategy, configurable max-page/limit parameter, crawl depth controls, independent or hands-on corroboration of crawl behavior.
